name: c2_agent_team
description: E1 system C2: the supervisor and specialist agents (graph/agent_workflow.py) talking to the simulated citizen, which plays each case from its hidden profile. Models come from SUPERVISOR_MODEL, SPECIALIST_MODEL and CITIZEN_MODEL (a different family). The supervisor's rate limit is raised to rate_limit_per_minute, because the simulated citizen answers far faster than a person; the limit itself is tested in E2.
